name: the play administered: steps that test, police, end and convert the April Fools frame
what_it_changes: K01 states that the host sub is keyed as play for April Fools and that a claim in it may be a joke. In these rooms the frame gains steps that the statement does not hold. Members test whether a claim is a joke by its date, source or link. They police the licence's limits and argue about when it ends. Moderators enforce a takeover's rules by real removals and switch its styling off. A joke can turn into a sincere request or a lasting change. The steps belong to the sub's own play beside the canvas, not to canvas work.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the takeover run as a temporary regime
what_it_changes: Within F01, a takeover's play becomes a temporary regime: its rules are enforced by real removals, bans and bots, members perform and test them, its styling is made usable or switched off, and its end is set.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the joke tested: members check a claim's truth
what_it_changes: Within F01, members test whether a claim is a joke before they act on it: by its date, its source, its plausibility or its marks, and they repair a literal reading.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the licence policed: objections to the play, its limits and its end
what_it_changes: Within F01, members object to the play and police the licence: they set limits on taste and repetition, demand labels, deletion, restoration or better jokes, and dispute when the licence ends.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the styling ended: ordinary use restored
what_it_changes: Within F01, members and moderators end the prank's styling and restore ordinary use: they switch styles off, ask whether the sub has switched back, and clear what the prank left.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the joke kept: a request that its change last
what_it_changes: Within F01, members ask that a joke's change outlast the day: a temporary feature, mode, flair, banner or board is to become permanent, or a joke activity real.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the telling clause not shown at the design: informed members reject the planned change
what_it_changes: P05's added clause says that a planned change is repaired away until its keepers are told. In these rooms the lines limit the clause where the design is settled. About half say that members who know of the change reject it, so repair or recolouring enforces a competing design, and telling does not settle it. The others say the record does not show the untold keepers, the agreed change or the loss that the clause needs. The frozen clause holds here only in part.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: machine hands kept on one target: installing, teaching and updating every runner
what_it_changes: P14 says the room adjusts its machine hands. In these rooms the adjusting is a step of its own: members install the script and teach it, and they keep every runner's target current, because a stale target undoes the room's own new design. A revision must reach the operator and the target file, not only the people.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the move returns to building: relocation followed by renewed construction
what_it_changes: The model runs from building to keeping and, after a loss, to the move (P10), but no arrow runs from the move back to building. In these rooms it does: after a relocation the room recruits, designs and builds again at the new spot, and members report the new work.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: a deal carried out as work: prepared in the room, then implemented and relayed
what_it_changes: P08 says rooms propose, settle and contest deals and hold each other to them. In these rooms a deal also takes work around it: members prepare it inside the room (local consensus, a contact, checks on the counterpart's credibility), and they carry it out by moving placed work, changing templates and bot targets, and relaying the terms to placers who do not know them.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: carrying on as renewed work, begun before the close
what_it_changes: P13 says that near the close and after it the room decides what of its effort to keep. In these rooms carrying on is work in its own right, and it starts while placement is live: on another canvas the room recruits, builds and defends again, members remake the work in other media, and the mark is adopted into the room before the close.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the spine restarted on another canvas
what_it_changes: Within F11, the room carries its work to a successor canvas, and there the spine runs again: recruiting, choosing a site, building, defending and losing work.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the work remade in other media, often before the close
what_it_changes: Within F11, members remake the canvas work elsewhere (fan art, games, physical copies, a quoted text), and this often begins while the original is still live.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the mark adopted as the room's emblem while it is still placed, damage included
what_it_changes: Within F11, the room takes the mark into its own sub (banner, flair, a room feature) during placement, and it may adopt the damaged form as fitting.

name: the plan kept current: correcting, updating and re-circulating the template
what_it_changes: P04 says members circulate a template or coordinates and ask strays to keep to them. In these rooms the template needs upkeep of its own: members correct the reference against the canvas, replace stale plans, make updates noticeable, route helpers to the current version and message friendly placers who still follow a superseded one.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the chat kept open: invitations renewed, entrants screened, outcomes relayed to the thread
what_it_changes: P23 (a candidate) says members move planning into a chat and invite helpers. In these rooms the chat's access is upkeep: members replace expired invitations and broken links, screen who comes in, and relay decisions back to the thread for those outside.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the marking provisional and contested: success judged and credit disputed while the work goes on
what_it_changes: P11 says that when a work is up the room marks it: announces, celebrates and credits. In these rooms marking comes while the work is still live and is open to dispute: success is judged by what survives, completion is provisional, upkeep goes on, and credit is challenged and corrected.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: success judged while upkeep continues
what_it_changes: Within F17, the room judges success by recognizable survival rather than a perfect mark, treats completion as a milestone, and keeps the obligation to maintain.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: credit contested during the work
what_it_changes: Within F17, members dispute and correct who made the work while it is still being placed: accusations, denials, competing labour claims and corrected omissions.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the close as news: late arrivals told that placement has ended
what_it_changes: P12 says the room records what happened and marks the end. In these rooms the end itself must travel: members who did not know offer to rebuild or ask for help, and others tell them that placement has ended and correct the stale call.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the canvas call not a joke: the April Fools frame kept apart from the canvas work
what_it_changes: K01 says that a claim in the host sub, a call to the canvas included, may be a joke. In these rooms the play stays with the sub's own business: its fakes and takeovers do not make the canvas calls jokes, and the frame does not decide what the canvas work was.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: help conditional on the helper's own work and spare hands
what_it_changes: P16 says rooms help one another, trade help and turn requests away. In these rooms help waits on conditions the statement does not hold: the helper's own work must be safe or finished, the helper must have pixels and time to spare, and the terms (space, non-interference, recognizable help) must hold.
kind_note: majority kind of the members' lines on the keys; not relied on for add-condition, add-step and restrict (J after the D3c interview)

name: the close scoped to the original canvas: continuation renewed, uncertain and contested
what_it_changes: P13 places the decision near the close and after it. In these rooms the stop at hour 73 binds only the original canvas: on successor canvases placement goes on, and continuation is often one member's attempt, contested or unfinished, and conditioned on tolerable upkeep and access.

name: machine hands debated, not shown placing

name: carrying on in talk: proposals and single attempts, not shown taken up

name: the telling clause not shown at the border: informed members contest the terms

name: the marking returns to keeping: celebration followed by renewed defence
